body: Person explicitly selected foundation_checkpoint: accept a foundation-only recovery checkpoint and retain the complete feature/all original end-to-end requirements in Sprint 2. The full original x1-x4 outcomes remain copied into Sprint 2. Reconcile this active scope in the desktop, Save draft revision 3 (or its desktop-edited successor), and adopt it. Then return control to the orchestrator to run DM-719/full gate and submit a fresh truthful report; only afterward Approve & advance. Current full gate has NOT run.
